_template_notes: cdg-tokens.json — CDG accept/reject tokens. Init bởi Phase 1 (stub), APPEND bởi Phase 4 Step 4.3 (E090/E090b browser CDG), APPEND bởi Phase 5 Step 5.7 (CDG Pre-Execute Handoff). Phase 6 PRE-GATE aggregate từ cả 3 paths (v10.10.0). Schema: cdg-tokens-v1.
_how_to_use: APPEND token: `jq '.tokens += [{id, severity, prompt, options, decision, decided_at, decided_by}]' SRC > TMP && jq '.' TMP > /dev/null && mv TMP SRC` (atomic CORE-035). KHÔNG WRITE template thẳng — sẽ giữ {{SESSION_ID}} placeholder.
